text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Trainy! Thanks for giving me the day 
off!
choice_data_list: Were you able to get some proper rest?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, naturally. If I'm told to rest, I 
have to live up to those expectations 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Weeell then. Next it's Trainy's turn to 
live up to expectations.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
While I was resting, you came up with an 
extraordinary training regimen for me, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now that's what I'm talking about! Give it 
everything you've got, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished her rest, Hishi Amazon 
seems itching for action!
